title: I Printed the Badge-Printer Quota After They Ran Visitor Stickers on My Code

parts.text: I scanned code 7 at 9:16 a.m. and the quota was already empty of visitor stickers I did not print. Reception Fran said codes were communal. I was thirty, coordinator, holding a print log. I printed the quota, the log, and Fran's name on forty stickers. Facilities issued unique codes. Fran prints visitors on reception's. The machine finally looks like a quota, not a party favor. The rule looks ordinary now, which is the whole point.

social.video_title: They ran visitor stickers on my badge-printer code — Part 1/1
social.description: Empty quota, forty stickers, a reception name. Has a printer ever billed only your code?
